shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'rg --files app lib __agent_eval__ && rg -n "" app lib next.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- next.config.ts lib/products.ts app/products/'[slug]'/page.tsx && rg -n \"dynamic\\s*=|revalidate\\s*=|fetchCache\\s*=|force-dynamic|force-static|no-store\" app lib next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json next.config.ts && rg -n "export const (dynamic|revalidate|fetchCache)|force-dynamic|force-static|no-store" app lib next.config.ts || true'
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- .gitignore next-env.d.ts tsconfig.json next.config.ts lib/products.ts app/products/'[slug]'/page.tsx"
